title: Corneal integrity and thickness of central fovea after phacoemulsification surgery in diabetic and nondiabetic cataract patients

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Cataract scheduled for routine phacoemulsification and IOL implantation; one eye per patient; diabetic group = type II diabetes mellitus under good control without severe diabetic complications; ocular diseases affecting the endothelium or macula and intraoperative complications excluded

groups.description: Phacoemulsification through a 3.2 mm temporal clear corneal incision with hydrophobic acrylic IOL in the bag, same surgeon team; nondiabetic patients
Same phacoemulsification procedure; patients with type II diabetes mellitus (patient-condition subgroup)

series.baseline_label: Preoperative day 1 (baseline) (Table III, Endothelial cell density block)
series.notes: Table III 'Nondiabetic group' column, rows preoperative day 1 (baseline), postoperative day 3, 1 week, 1, 3 and 6 months; data as mean ± SD; postoperative day 3 = 3/30.4375 and 1 week = 7/30.4375 months. Per-visit n not tabulated.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative day 1 (baseline) (Table III, Endothelial cell density block)
series.notes: Table III 'Diabetic group' column, rows preoperative day 1 (baseline), postoperative day 3, 1 week, 1, 3 and 6 months; data as mean ± SD; postoperative day 3 = 3/30.4375 and 1 week = 7/30.4375 months. Per-visit n not tabulated.

exclusions.what: Table III hexagonal cells, coefficient of variation, central corneal thickness and central foveal thickness blocks

notes: Role: diabetes is a patient condition; both groups had the same standard phacoemulsification, so both are control-role groups.
Table III labels the ECD unit 'cells/m2'; the values are central ECD in cells/mm2 (Methods: Konan SP-9000p specular microscopy, at least 40 cells).
Results: all patients completed the 6-month follow-up and were included in the analyses.
